rules.when: Mechanical upkeep with no design judgment: rebasing a branch onto its base, resolving CHANGELOG or lockfile merge conflicts, re-running a pipeline, version bumps, or a rote rename or formatting sweep.
rules.why: Mechanical upkeep goes to Haiku 5.5 at medium.

rules.when: Any scout, scan, check, investigation, experiment or audit whose deliverable is a report: diagnosing an unclear failure, comparing designs, measuring tool configurations, auditing code or configuration.
rules.why: Reports need more reasoning than implementation but not the strongest model; scouts, scans and checks run on Sonnet 5.5 at high.

rules.when: Planning a large, complex or high-risk task before implementation (a written plan for a Sonnet worker to execute), or reviewing the code a Sonnet worker has finished (a read-only code review that reports findings and changes nothing).
rules.why: Opus 5.5 is used only for planning and read-only code review.
